title: The Pit
text: Trona High School plays football on a field of dirt and sand called The Pit, because the salt in the soil kills grass. The school's teams are the Tornadoes, but the football players call themselves the Sandmen.

s1.title: Searles Valley, California
s1.quote: The local school plays on a dirt football field because the high level of salt kills grass.

s2.title: Trona High football hits harder than Mother Nature
s2.quote: The desert heat and salty soil refuse to let anything grow in The Pit. ... the football players call themselves the Sandmen
